chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Humayri narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Kalib ibn Mu'awiya al-Asadi, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):

Your followers say: The pilgrim's family and wealth are under Allah's guarantee, and he may leave behind (unpaid debts or obligations) regarding his family, and I see that he departs and brings about new events (or changes) for his family.

He (peace be upon him) said: He only leaves behind for them what he was responsible for fulfilling; as for what was present (and due) which he was unable to pay, then no (it is not left behind/guaranteed).

key_terms.يَخْلُفُ: To leave behind (as in debts or obligations)

ai.seo_question: What happens to a Muslim's debts and family obligations when they go on Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the concept of *daman Allah* (divine guarantee) for the pilgrim, distinguishing between pre-existing financial liabilities that remain the pilgrim's responsibility and unforeseen events that occur during the journey. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that spiritual protection does not absolve one of settled debts or ongoing duties incurred prior to departure, ensuring that the pilgrim's departure does not unjustly burden their family with neglected obligations. The discussion highlights the balance between divine mercy and legal accountability in Islamic finance and family law.

en.basel-kadem: 84.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from his father, from Qasem bin Muhammed al-Jawhari, from Isma’eel bin Ibrahim, from Abu Mu’awiya al-Ashtar, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say: The one who complains to a believer has certainly complained to Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, and the one who complains to an opponent (of us) has certainly complained about Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He.
